canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Casa Marcial

parent.title: A weekend around Casa Marcial — Arriondas, Asturias

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Casa Marcial
siblings.summary: Nothing is truly walkable from Casa Marcial; the closest sub-2 km option is El Interior de Gaia, but the practical play is staying in Arriondas town and taking a taxi.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Casa Marcial
siblings.summary: A curated map of the Picos foothills, Sella canoe, coast and cider houses sitting within a half-hour of Arriondas — with 2026 prices, shuttle rules and what slips just outside the 30 km radius.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Casa Marcial
siblings.summary: Nothing inside 30 km — Casa Marcial is in deep rural eastern Asturias. The nearest tech scene is Oviedo/Gijón at ~55–75 km.

sources.title: OAD Guides — Casa Marcial
sources.claim: Casa Marcial's address: Calle La Salgar, s/n, 33549 Arriondas, Parres, Asturias — a hamlet 3 km outside Arriondas town.

sources.title: Casa Marcial — Casa
sources.claim: Casa Marcial does not run its own lodging; the only accommodation it links is Narbasu.

sources.title: Casa Marcial — Manzano
sources.claim: Narbasu is the Manzano siblings' own restaurant-and-hotel, 20 min from Casa Marcial in a 14th-c. palace.

sources.title: Narbasu — Hotel
sources.claim: Narbasu has 23 rooms in the Palacio de Rubianes at Cereceda, Piloña; open Thursday–Sunday.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Narbasu
sources.claim: Narbasu's restaurant holds one Michelin Green Star under chefs Esther and Nacho Manzano.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Arriondas to Cereceda
sources.claim: Taxi from Arriondas to Cereceda is roughly 9 minutes and €20–€25.

sources.title: Puebloastur Eco-Resort & Spa
sources.claim: Puebloastur is a 5★ hotel in Cofiño (Parres), awarded 'Gran Lujo' — Asturias's highest hospitality distinction — in 2025.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Puebloastur
sources.claim: Puebloastur is ~1.8 mi from Casa Marcial; 28–30 rooms; full spa; 9-m Dalí sculpture; ~$512–$814/night.

sources.title: Palacio de Cutre
sources.claim: Palacio de Cutre is a stone palace with wall, tower and chapel in La Goleta, Piloña, with seasonal Asturian cuisine on-site.

sources.title: Booking.com — Palacio de Cutre
sources.claim: Palacio de Cutre averages 9.1/10 on Booking with Staff 9.6 and Comfort 9.3; no A/C; GPS struggles to find access road.

sources.title: Rural Iberica — Hotel Aultre Naray
sources.claim: Hotel Aultre Naray is an 1873 casona in Peruyes (Cangas de Onís), restored in 1995, with chestnut beams and Paco Terán interiors.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Hotel Casona del Sella
sources.claim: Casona del Sella is a 1923 Indiano-style mansion at Plaza Venancio Pando, 14 rooms, walkability 83/100, $87–$129/night.

sources.title: asturias.com — La Raposera
sources.claim: La Raposera is a 1917 Indiano mansion in Caravia, rehabilitated 2014, 6 rooms on a 5,000 m² farm, no restaurant, adults/teens 14+ only.

sources.title: Hotel El Babú
sources.claim: Hotel El Babú is an 18th-c. Asturian manor on the N-632 (km 17), 7 rooms, renewable energy, buffet breakfast.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Hotels near Casa Marcial
sources.claim: Closest hotels: Puebloastur 1.8 mi, Casona del Sella 2.0 mi, El Texu 2.8 mi, La Raposera 3.1 mi (5.0★).

sources.title: Travels for Stars — Casa Marcial
sources.claim: One Casa Marcial diner used Ribadesella (~30 min drive) as a coastal base.

sources.title: Hotel El Quintanal
sources.claim: Hotel El Quintanal is a renovated Asturian manor in Bode, 2 km from Arriondas, with 11 rooms (2 Junior Suites).
